sections.title: Experimental software — testing purposes only
sections.text: The strategy module is an experimental beta provided solely for evaluation and testing. It may contain defects, behave unexpectedly, become unavailable, or lose data. It is not represented as suitable for production use or for safeguarding funds. Enabling it does not start a strategy or authorize any particular trade.

sections.title: Financial risk and your decisions
sections.text: You voluntarily assume the risks of using the beta, including loss of all funds used with it, unintended or duplicate transactions, failed or delayed orders, missed exits, slippage, price volatility, fees, and smart-contract, network, RPC, wallet, exchange, solver, bridge or other third-party failures. Blockchain transactions may be irreversible. Stops and take-profit orders do not guarantee execution or prevent losses. Use only amounts you can afford to lose. You alone choose assets, settings, permissions and trades, monitor activity, maintain wallet backups and security, and meet applicable legal and tax obligations.

sections.title: No advice or promises
sections.text: DEKXDIS, its developers, contributors and operators (the DEKXDIS parties) do not provide investment, financial, tax or legal advice through the beta. Examples, signals, projections and past performance are not recommendations or guarantees. No profit, performance, availability, accuracy, security or compatibility is promised. To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, the beta is provided AS IS and AS AVAILABLE, without express or implied warranties, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement.

sections.title: Assumption of risk and limitation of liability
sections.text: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, you accept responsibility for your use of the beta and the resulting losses, costs and consequences, and release the DEKXDIS parties from claims arising from that use. To that same extent, the DEKXDIS parties are not liable for financial or trading losses, lost profits, loss of digital assets or data, interrupted operations, or direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages arising from the beta, including defects or negligence, even if advised of the possibility. No provision excludes liability that applicable law does not allow to be excluded.

sections.title: Your obligations and third-party claims
sections.text: You confirm that you are legally able to enter this agreement and authorized to use the wallets and assets involved. You will use the beta lawfully. To the fullest extent permitted by law, you agree to indemnify the DEKXDIS parties against third-party claims, damages and reasonable costs arising from your unlawful use, breach of this agreement or infringement of another person’s rights; this does not cover liability that law requires the DEKXDIS parties to bear.

sections.title: Your rights and acceptance
sections.text: Nothing in this agreement waives mandatory consumer protections or other rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be waived. If a provision is unenforceable, the remaining provisions continue to apply to the extent allowed by law. You may decline and keep using the ordinary terminal with strategies locked. Selecting I agree and enable beta records this agreement version and the acceptance time on this computer and unlocks beta strategy access. It does not transfer responsibility for other people’s conduct to you.
